name: agentic-playwright-mcp

tools.name: browser_tab_group
tools.description:
Manage tab groups for session isolation. Actions: create, list, delete.
create: returns groupId. Pass it to browser_tabs.
list: MCP isolation groups and native Chrome groups with tab counts.
delete: removes the group and closes its tabs, unless closeTabs is false.
A group is removed automatically after its last tab closes.
Prefer a human-readable group name under 20 characters.
When agents share one browser, each creates its own group, so one agent never lists or closes another agent's tabs.

name.description: Group name, for action create. Prefer a human-readable name under 20 characters.

color.description: Group colour in Chrome, for action create. Needs companion extension.

closeTabs.description: Close the group's tabs on delete. Default true.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description:
Manage tabs. Actions: list, new, close, select.
list: with groupId, only that MCP group's tabs. Without groupId, all tabs. When the companion extension is available, each tab also shows its native Chrome group.
new: creates tab and returns its targetId. Keep that id for every later call.
close, select: pass targetId or index.
When more than one agent shares this browser, create a group with browser_tab_group first and pass groupId. Ungrouped tabs still work for one agent.

groupId.description: Group name from browser_tab_group. Scopes this call to that group.

url.description: URL for action new. Default about:blank.

index.description: Tab index for close or select. Relative to the group when groupId is set.

targetId.description: Tab id for close or select, instead of index.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate tab to URL.

targetId.description: Tab id from browser_tabs. Default first tab.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Accessibility tree of the page, with refs (e1, e2) for click, type, hover. Only elements with an accessible role get a ref. For role-less div or span, pass a CSS selector in element instead. Refs die after navigation or DOM change, so snapshot again.

targetId.description: Tab id from browser_tabs. Default first tab.

maxChars.description: Truncate snapshot at this many characters. Try 5000 to 15000.

compact.description: Drop unnamed structural elements and empty branches.

interactive.description: Keep only interactive elements: button, link, input. Smallest output.

maxDepth.description: Max tree depth. 0 is root only. Try 3 to 5 on complex pages.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click element by snapshot ref, or by CSS selector in element.

element.description: CSS selector instead of ref. Use when snapshot gives no ref, such as role-less div or span. Cannot combine with ref.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into element.

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.description: Hover element by snapshot ref, or by CSS selector in element.

element.description: CSS selector instead of ref. Use when snapshot gives no ref, such as role-less div or span. Cannot combine with ref.

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press keyboard key on focused element.

tools.name: browser_fill_form
tools.description: Fill many form fields in one call.

fields.description: Fields to fill. Each needs ref and type.

tools.name: browser_wait_for
tools.description: Wait for condition: text, selector, url, load state, or time.

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Run JS in page via page.evaluate(). Use for elements the snapshot omits: portal div, framework overlay, shadow DOM. Can click hidden element, read data, change DOM. Cross-origin fetch fails CORS here, so use browser_run_code_unsafe with page.request.

expression.description: JS expression or function. Example: `document.title` or `() => document.querySelector('.menu').click()`. With ref: `(el) => el.textContent`.

ref.description: Snapshot ref, such as e1. Expression gets element as first argument.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot page or one element. Pass ref or element to capture one element. Omit both to capture the viewport. Default saves to file and returns the path, which keeps image data out of the context window.

element.description: CSS selector instead of ref. Ignored when ref is set.

fullPage.description: Capture full scrollable page instead of viewport. Default false. Not compatible with ref or element.

type.description: Image format. Default png. jpeg gives smaller files.

quality.description: jpeg quality, 1-100. Default 80. Lower is smaller. Only applies when type is jpeg.

maxWidth.description: Max width in pixels. Scales down proportionally when wider.

returnAs.description: file saves to disk and returns the path, which keeps image data out of the context window. base64 returns inline image data. Default file.

savePath.description: File path to save to. Only used when returnAs is file. Default ~/.agentic-playwright-mcp/screenshots/ with a timestamp name.

tools.name: browser_checkpoint
tools.description: Capture structured checkpoint for one tab. Writes artifacts and a manifest under the server checkpoint directory.

highlightSelector.description: CSS selector to highlight in the screenshot.

collectors.description: Per-collector overrides. Set a collector to false to disable it, or pass options.

tools.name: browser_checkpoint_report
tools.description: Generate report from stored checkpoint manifests.

format.description: One report format per call. Default html.

resultsDir.description: Directory holding checkpoint manifests. Default server-managed results directory.

tools.name: browser_console_messages
tools.description: Console messages from page. Filter by minimum level.

level.description: Return only this level or above.

tools.name: browser_network_requests
tools.description: List network requests this tab made, numbered from 1. Pass that index to browser_network_request for headers and body.

filter.description: Return only URLs containing this substring.

tools.name: browser_network_request
tools.description: Headers and body for one network request, by index from browser_network_requests.

part.description: Return only this part. Omit for all.

filter.description: Pass the same filter you used when listing, so indexes match.

maxChars.description: Truncate body to this many characters. Default 200000.

tools.name: browser_network_response_body
tools.description: Response body for URL matching pattern. Checks traffic this tab already made, then waits timeoutMs for new match. Chrome drops cached bodies after a while, and then this tool says so instead of returning empty body. Re-fetch with browser_run_code_unsafe and page.request.

url.description: Full URL, or substring to match. Full URL is safer.

maxChars.description: Truncate body to this many characters. Default 200000.

timeoutMs.description: Wait this long for new match. Default 20000.

tools.name: browser_page_errors
tools.description: Uncaught JS errors from page.

tools.name: browser_select_option
tools.description: Select options in a <select> dropdown.

tools.name: browser_file_upload
tools.description: Set files on file input. Pass inputRef or element, not both.

inputRef.description: Snapshot ref of the file input.

element.description: CSS selector of the file input, instead of inputRef.

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.description: Drag from one element to another. Each side takes a snapshot ref or a CSS selector.

startElement.description: CSS selector to drag from, instead of startRef. Drag handles are usually role-less div with no snapshot ref.

endElement.description: CSS selector to drop onto, instead of endRef.

tools.name: browser_resize
tools.description: Resize tab viewport.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Close tab. Inside a tab group, prefer browser_tabs with action close.

targetId.description: Tab id to close. Default first tab.

tools.name: browser_navigate_back
tools.description: Go back in tab history, or forward.

tools.name: browser_find
tools.description: Search accessibility snapshot for text or regex. Returns matching lines with context. Cheaper than a full snapshot when you only need to locate one element.

text.description: Case-insensitive substring. Pass text or regex, not both.

regex.description: Regular expression. Wrap in slashes for flags: "/error/i".

tools.name: browser_handle_dialog
tools.description: Accept or dismiss alert, confirm, prompt. Handles a dialog already open, otherwise arms the next dialog on this tab. To control the answer, arm before the click that opens the dialog. An unanswered dialog blocks the tab, so the server auto-dismisses it after about 3 seconds.

promptText.description: Text to enter in a prompt dialog.

tools.name: browser_drop
tools.description: Drop files or MIME data onto element, as if dragged from outside the page. Pass paths, data, or both.

element.description: CSS selector instead of ref. Drop zones are usually role-less div with no snapshot ref. Cannot combine with ref.

paths.description: Absolute file paths. Uses the file input when ref is one.

tools.name: browser_run_code_unsafe
tools.description: Run Playwright code against one tab. Code gets the `page` object, so the whole Playwright API works: page.request, page.evaluate, page.context().cookies(), page.pdf. Use it for authenticated HTTP calls, since page.request runs Node-side and skips CORS, and to filter large responses before they reach the model. Warning: this tool runs arbitrary JavaScript inside the Playwright MCP server process, which is equivalent to remote code execution on the host machine.

code.description: JavaScript function taking page as its only argument. Example: `async (page) => { await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click(); return await page.title(); }`

filename.description: Load code from this file. Relative path resolves against server working directory. Overrides code when both are set.

timeoutMs.description: Abort snippet after this many milliseconds. Default 120000.
